title: Reflection Coefficient
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the reflection coefficient R = ((n-1)/(n+1))^2.

title: Radiation Pressure
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the radiation pressure P = 2I/c * ((1-n)/(1+n)).

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply boundary conditions for electric and magnetic fields at the interface.

title: Momentum Density
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly explain the concept of momentum density in relation to radiation pressure.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors in the derivation of the reflection coefficient.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a physical interpretation of the results in terms of energy transfer.

title: Alternative Methods
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explore alternative methods for calculating the reflection coefficient or radiation pressure.
